event.selection_basis: PG&E's CPUC-hosted post-event report states it began de-energizing at 2021-08-17 17:00 PDT, identifies Shasta among counties with de-energized time-places, and reports a Shasta weather-station maximum gust. This is planned de-energization evidence only.
exclusions: No matched EAGLE-I county-time-series receipt has been collected.
uncertainties: The report-wide 17:00 PDT start is not a Shasta-specific activation; Appendix B lists individual Shasta circuit starts later that evening.
The reported maximum gust is a county-scope station summary, not a complete six-hour county weather series.
The utility report is not independent verification of wildfire causation, fire occurrence, or a county outage label.

source_receipts.release: PG&E PSPS Post Event Report, August 17-19 2021 De-Energization Event
source_receipts.license_or_access: Public CPUC-hosted filing; no explicit reuse license was identified in the retrieved PDF.
source_receipts.units: Reported local Pacific time, customers, and weather-station maximum gusts in mph; no county six-hour EAGLE-I outage units supplied.
source_receipts.timezone_conversion: Report's 2021 local operational times are PDT (UTC-07:00): 2021-08-17 17:00 PDT = 2021-08-18T00:00:00Z. Appendix B identifies Shasta circuit starts in PDT.
source_receipts.filters: Retrieved post-event PDF only; candidate record selects Shasta County (FIPS 06089) and the UTC six-hour interval beginning at the report-wide planned activation.
source_receipts.grid_index_mapping: No EAGLE-I county rows or gridded weather values mapped; Appendix B provides circuit-level Shasta planned de-energization timing but no EAGLE-I label series.
